routes.name: Aukštaitija Lakes Ride
routes.via: Vilnius → Asveja → Molėtai → Labanoras → Aukštaitija NP → Zarasai
routes.summary: A full Saturday through the lake country with the national park's gravel roads in the afternoon, a night in Zarasai, and a relaxed paved return on Sunday.

routes.name: Asveja Twisties Loop
routes.via: Vilnius → Kernavė → Širvintos → Dubingiai → Molėtai → Labanoras → Pabradė → Vilnius
routes.summary: A riding-first day loop over the two best-rated corner roads in Lithuania, back through Labanoras forest. Stops are fuel, lunch and a couple of five-minute views.
